article.title: *The Disappearance of Josef Mengele*
article.excerpt: A novel, one of the best books of the year, also short and readable. The author is from Strasbourg. “I’ve read enough about the Holocaust” is not a good reason to avoid iihs book. Here is a short review , and you can buy it here . How does in fact a sophisticated doctor become a Nazi and then frame that decision to himself? Definitely recommended.
